css: body{margin:10px 16px}.dashboard{height:130px;display:grid;grid-template-rows:18px 34px 62px;gap:8px}header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}header strong{font-size:13px}header small{font-size:11px}.stages{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}.stages li{border-top:4px solid var(--studio-border);padding-top:4px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:6px;font-size:11px;color:var(--studio-muted)}.stages li span{font-size:10px}.stages .done{border-color:#7bbba4;color:var(--studio-text)}.stages .active{border-color:var(--studio-accent);color:var(--studio-text);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a399ff18,transparent)}.readout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) minmax(0,2.4fr);gap:8px}.metric{border:1px solid var(--studio-border);border-radius:var(--studio-radius);background:var(--studio-surface);padding:6px 12px;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:9px}.metric b{font-size:28px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.metric span{font-size:11px;color:var(--studio-muted)}.issue{border-color:#d6a27066}.issue b{color:#e4b889}aside{border-left:2px solid #d6a270;padding:3px 12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;overflow:hidden}aside small,aside span{font-size:10px;color:var(--studio-muted)}aside strong{font-size:12px}aside span,aside strong{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}@media(max-width:600px){header small,.stages li span{display:none}.readout{gap:4px;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) minmax(0,1.8fr)}.metric{padding:4px 6px;flex-direction:column;gap:0}.metric b{font-size:22px;line-height:1.1}.metric span{font-size:10px}aside{padding:3px 6px}aside strong{white-space:normal;font-size:11px}}
